context.transcript:
Good morning.
The main focus of today's meeting is our bus company's quarterly earnings.
Overall we're doing well, but there has been a noticeable drop in ticket sales on routes to Cooper City.
Cooper City was once a major tourist destination, but since several museums closed in the historic district, fewer passengers choose to go there.
This will now be the third quarter in a row of a steady decline in ticket purchases, so I think it best to reduce the number of bus trips to that location to just one a day.
I've created an updated schedule that reflects this change.
Please look it over and let me know what you think.
context.transcript_translation:
大家早上好。
今天会议主要讨论我们巴士公司的季度收益。
总体而言，我们经营得不错，但前往 Cooper City 各条线路的车票销量明显下降了。
Cooper City 曾是一个重要的旅游目的地，但自从历史街区的几家博物馆关闭后，选择前往那里的乘客减少了。
这将是购票量连续稳步下降的第三个季度，所以我认为最好将前往那里的巴士班次减少到每天一班。
我已经制作了一份体现这一调整的新时刻表。
请大家查看，并告诉我你们的想法。
